mas_config.mas_context: The MAS generates a follow-up research proposal in a [Question 1]-[Question 5] format by leveraging the expertise and perspectives of three renowned authors: Geoffrey Hinton, Oriol Vinyals, and Jeff Dean. Each author contributes a proposal candidate based on their past publications, which are then aggregated into a cohesive final proposal.
